等级与类型怎么定
  • 严重阻塞交付，或造成数据丢失、安全问题，且没有合理绕行

  • 能力缺口需求属于框架职责，但缺少能力或公开接入
  • 指引错误指引、示例或注释写错，或彼此矛盾，照做会出错

轻微实现缺陷上游未复核
F4 · 模板提交 e318f4e 在 app/AGENTS.md 引入多余空行，使 format:check 失败并消耗一次修复

应用模板 · app/AGENTS.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

框架提交 e318f4e（test: add opt-in controlled failed delivery smoke #404）在 app/AGENTS.md 的 ## Controlled failed-delivery smoke 前新增了两个空行；prettier . --check '!.github/**' 因此标记 AGENTS.md，verify-1 的 format:check 以 exit 1 结束，修复轮随后只做删除一个空行的空白修改。

实际影响
从模板生成的干净应用无法通过其自身的 format:check，把与业务无关的格式问题变成必须消耗修复预算的失败，并让 Agent 面对“能否修改框架指引文件”的不确定。
建议改法
在模板源头修正 e318f4e 引入的空行，并让模板 CI 对 app/AGENTS.md 运行 prettier --check，避免把格式缺陷带进每个新应用。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
在干净模板上运行仓库自带的 pnpm format:check（prettier . --check '!.github/**'）。
应有能力 / 行为
模板自带的 app/AGENTS.md 通过仓库自身的 Prettier 校验，新应用无需修改框架指引即可通过 format:check。
实际观察
app/AGENTS.md 被 prettier 标记为格式错误，format:check 以 exit 1 结束；修复轮删除多余空行后才通过。
应用绕行与代价
应用修复轮直接在 app/AGENTS.md 删除 e318f4e 增加的一个空行；这是对应用副本的空白修改，上游模板提交未变。
改进后的验收标准
从模板生成的干净应用在未修改 app/AGENTS.md 的情况下通过 pnpm format:check。

app/tests/logic/app-server.test.ts:860–919E32

端到端测试向 test-inbox 发送后等待 status=completed 且 delivery 为 accepted，再向 test-failure 发送并等待 failed，断言 lastError 的 code/message 匹配 ENOTFOUND 或 EAI_AGAIN 或 notification-test.invalid。

          channel: 'test-inbox',
          values: {
            recipient: userId,
            title: 'Notification test',
            body: 'Controlled normal delivery.',
          },
        }),
      },
    );
    expect(normal.status).toBe(202);
    const normalBody = (await normal.json()) as {
      data: { notificationId: string };
    };
    const normalStatus = await waitForNotificationTestStatus(
      app,
      baseUrl,
      apiHeaders,
      normalBody.data.notificationId,
      (status) => status === 'completed',
    );
    expect(normalStatus.deliveries[0].delivery.status).toBe('accepted');

    const failing = await requestApp(
      app,
      `${baseUrl}/api/notifications/test/send`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          ...apiHeaders,
          'content-type': 'application/json',
          'x-nocobase-notification-test': '1',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          channel: 'test-failure',
          values: {
            recipient: 'notification-test@example.invalid',
            subject: 'Notification test',
            text: 'Controlled failure.',
          },
        }),
      },
    );
    expect(failing.status).toBe(202);
    const failingBody = (await failing.json()) as {
      data: { notificationId: string };
    };
    const failureStatus = await waitForNotificationTestStatus(
      app,
      baseUrl,
      apiHeaders,
      failingBody.data.notificationId,
      (status) => status === 'failed',
    );
    const failure = failureStatus.deliveries[0];
    expect(failure.delivery.status).toBe('failed');
    // The provider's reason survives into the log instead of being replaced by
    // a generic error message.
    expect(
      `${failure.delivery.lastError?.code} ${failure.delivery.lastError?.message}`,
    ).toMatch(/ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|notification-test\.invalid/);

app/AGENTS.md:399–405E40

应用指引中的 Factory task termination 与 Controlled failed-delivery smoke 段落；后者正是模板提交 e318f4e 引入、随后被修复轮删除多余空行的段落。

Ordinary tasks and evaluation samples share the ceilings in `.github/scripts/task-policy.mjs`: five repair attempts, three observations of an identical failure per criterion/check, at most one five-hour Handoff, and ten hours of active implementation/repair/QA time. An evaluation plan can only tighten these limits. Pipeline state carries counters, failure fingerprints and elapsed time across handoffs and explicit recoveries; never clear them to get a task through.

A terminal limit saves `task-diagnostic.json` and `task-diagnostic.md`, preserves the patch and raw evidence, and runs at most one additional fifteen-minute read-only diagnosis using the independent reviewer. This cleanup cannot resume repairs, dispatch another continuation, or authorize final verification. Failed tasks still publish reports and create or update a build PR marked failed when a safe code diff exists. They may attempt preview packaging and deployment once without restarting repair or QA; preview failure does not block the report or PR or change the failed task status. Missing patches or empty diffs must be reported explicitly rather than fabricating a PR. Stopped checkpoints are not recoverable. Reject direct GitHub Re-run attempts for implementation/repair: they start fresh runners without restoring the previous attempt. Use explicit checkpoint recovery in a new Run for recoverable failures. Attribute framework, Skill, template, application, factory and environment issues from evidence; repeated failures alone are not proof of a NocoBase3 defect. Preserve unknown causes and incomplete diagnoses.

## Controlled failed-delivery smoke

The task workflow's opt-in failure_smoke dispatch input exercises failed publication without model calls or business QA. It requires a fresh, open Issue carrying factory:external, factory:failure-smoke, and the <!-- factory-failure-smoke:v1 --> disclosure. Do not use recovery or GitHub Re-run for this mode. The pinned code-only fixture comes from Issue #400 / PR #401; it carries its source SHA and patch digest and never copies earlier QA verdicts or screenshots. The agent job deliberately fails before QA; the existing failed PR, report, packaging and deployment jobs must handle it unchanged. Do not merge its application PR or describe successful preview deployment as successful business acceptance.

### [轻微][实现缺陷] 模板提交 e318f4e 在 app/AGENTS.md 引入多余空行，使 format:check 失败并消耗一次修复

**相关对象**：`app/AGENTS.md`

框架提交 e318f4e（test: add opt-in controlled failed delivery smoke #404）在 app/AGENTS.md 的 ## Controlled failed-delivery smoke 前新增了两个空行；prettier . --check '!.github/**' 因此标记 AGENTS.md，verify-1 的 format:check 以 exit 1 结束，修复轮随后只做删除一个空行的空白修改。

**影响**：从模板生成的干净应用无法通过其自身的 format:check，把与业务无关的格式问题变成必须消耗修复预算的失败，并让 Agent 面对“能否修改框架指引文件”的不确定。

**建议改动**：在模板源头修正 e318f4e 引入的空行，并让模板 CI 对 app/AGENTS.md 运行 prettier --check，避免把格式缺陷带进每个新应用。

**验收标准**：从模板生成的干净应用在未修改 app/AGENTS.md 的情况下通过 pnpm format:check。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `app/tests/logic/app-server.test.ts:860–919` — 端到端测试向 test-inbox 发送后等待 status=completed 且 delivery 为 accepted，再向 test-failure 发送并等待 failed，断言 lastError 的 code/message 匹配 ENOTFOUND 或 EAI_AGAIN 或 notification-test.invalid。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-1.jsonl/part-0001.txt:1645–1650` — 修复轮读取 .prettierignore 并运行 git show e318f4e -- AGENTS.md，输出显示该提交在 ## Controlled failed-delivery smoke 前新增了两个空行。
- `artifacts/agent-history/agent-repair-1.jsonl/part-0002.txt:1603–1604` — 修复轮用 edit 把 oldText 中 Preserve unknown causes... 后的两个空行改为一个空行，编辑成功并返回 diff。
- `app/AGENTS.md:399–405` — 应用指引中的 Factory task termination 与 Controlled failed-delivery smoke 段落；后者正是模板提交 e318f4e 引入、随后被修复轮删除多余空行的段落。

registry.testTargets 返回任何 enabled 且其 Provider messageType 定义了 test 的渠道，manager.resolveTestTarget 只校验渠道名在 listTestTargets 内；服务端没有把渠道标记为 test-only 的开关，也未在服务端强制排除业务渠道。本次隔离靠应用给渠道加 test- 前缀并在客户端 isTestChannel 过滤，服务端 /test/send 仍接受任何已列出的渠道。

实际影响
拥有 notification:test send 权限的调用者可在带 test 定义的业务渠道上发起真实外部发送，隔离强度取决于应用自觉而非框架保证。
建议改法
为渠道或测试面增加 test-only 标记或白名单（例如配置里显式声明 testTargets，或渠道上的 test 开关），并在 resolveTestTarget 中拒绝未标记渠道；或在 Skill 中明确要求应用在服务端强制隔离。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
应用配置一个同时带测试定义的业务渠道后，GET /api/notifications/test/targets 会把它列为目标，POST /api/notifications/test/send 也会接受该渠道名。
应有能力 / 行为
框架提供一种服务端手段把真实业务渠道排除在测试入口之外（白名单或 test-only 标记）。
实际观察
testTargets 与 resolveTestTarget 只看渠道是否 enabled 且 Provider 是否有 test 定义，没有业务/测试渠道区分；隔离完全由应用层前缀约定与客户端过滤实现。
应用绕行与代价
应用把测试渠道统一加 test- 前缀，并在客户端 isTestChannel 过滤；这是应用侧命名约定，服务端不受约束。
改进后的验收标准
未声明为 test-only 的渠道被 POST /api/notifications/test/send 拒绝且不产生真实发送，或 Skill 明确记录该限制由应用负责。

文档列出三个测试端点及其认证/测试头/权限差异，说明目标是注册定义与已启用实例的交集、只暴露安全元数据、每次测试都产生持久日志且状态仅创建者可见，并提示生产测试是真实对外发送。

## Notification test surface

The core package exposes `GET /api/notifications/test/targets`, `POST /api/notifications/test/send`, and `GET /api/notifications/test/:id/status`. All three require authentication and `x-nocobase-notification-test: 1`; only `POST /send` requires the `notification:test` `send` permission. Logs remain separately protected by `page:notification.logs` `access`.

Targets are the intersection of registered definitions and enabled configured instances. Their public descriptors contain only Channel names, Provider identifiers, labels, and safe form-field metadata. Configuration, Webhook URLs, API keys, and secrets stay on the server. Channel definitions convert test fields into the same normal `send()` inputs; each test creates persistent logs, and status is visible only to its creating user.

A production test is a real external send and requires explicit scope, the recipient or recipientless mode, Channel, permission, and follow-up verification.

本轮过程记录

Repaired the notification-test task's only observed failure: the repository-wide Prettier check failed on the template's AGENTS.md, which aborted the quality pipeline before typecheck/test/build. Removed the extra blank line introduced by framework commit e318f4e and re-verified the feature's scoped tests.

问题 01 · verification

format:check fails on the template's own AGENTS.md

本任务已处理

`pnpm format:check` (`prettier . --check '!.github/**'`) reported `[warn] AGENTS.md` and exited 1. Because `check` is `lint && format:check && typecheck && test && build`, and `format:auto` (format-changes.mjs) only formats files the agent's patch changed, the untouched AGENTS.md was never normalized, so the pipeline aborted before typecheck/test/build ever ran.

原因（实现者自述）
Framework/template commit e318f4e appended the 'Controlled failed-delivery smoke' section to AGENTS.md with two blank lines before the `##` heading; Prettier allows only one. AGENTS.md is a generated template file the factory overlay deliberately leaves untouched, and it was not part of the application patch, so no automatic formatting step corrected it.
处理方式
Removed the single extra blank line in AGENTS.md (whitespace-only). Verified with `npx prettier . --check '!.github/**'` (all matched files formatted) and re-ran the feature's scoped tests: `tests/logic/notification-test-target.test.ts`, `tests/logic/config.test.ts` (10 passed) and the `app-server.test.ts` case 'delivers a notification test to an isolated inbox and records a controlled failure' (passed, including normal in-app delivery and recorded controlled SMTP failure).
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · factory

Format the generated AGENTS.md in the refresh baseline

可自动化

The refresh overlay intentionally keeps the generated AGENTS.md untouched, so a formatting defect committed upstream to that file survives into every generated application and fails the repository-wide `format:check` on inspection. `format-changes.mjs` cannot repair it because the file is not part of the agent's patch.

建议改动

Normalize the template's AGENTS.md (run Prettier over it) as part of the template refresh, or include it in the files `format-changes.mjs` is allowed to rewrite on a repair retry.

提供一个最小的测试发送入口，把一次测试通知发往明确隔离的测试收件端（不触达真实客户或真实群组）。直接支持
框架职责与业务边界
框架提供测试发送 HTTP 契约与目标描述符：GET /test/targets 暴露安全字段元数据，POST /test/send 走与正常发送相同的 send() 输入，请求体由严格 schema 校验；应用负责选择隔离渠道并钉住收件人。
推荐使用方式
使用已认证会话并携带 x-nocobase-notification-test: 1 调用三个测试端点，POST /send 额外需要 notification:test send 权限；只提供目标要求的字段，凭据留在服务端（E9/E10）。
Agent 实际使用
app 的 api.ts 以固定测试头调用 targets/send，页面把收件人钉为当前登录用户或保留的 .invalid 邮箱；测试目标由 app/server/config/notification.ts 中的 test-inbox 与 test-failure 定义。

        if (result.status === 'submission_unknown') {

                error: result.error,

        }
        const failedAttempt = {
            ...attempt,
            status: 'failed',
            finishedAt,
            error: result.error,
        };
        if (result.disposition === 'same_provider') {
            if (current.attemptCount < this.maxAttempts) {
                const retryAt = new Date(Date.parse(finishedAt) + this.retryDelay(result.retryAfterMs)).toISOString();
                return this.finishAttemptAndDelivery(failedAttempt, current, 'retrying', result.error, retryAt);
            }
        }
        return this.finishAttemptAndDelivery(failedAttempt, current, 'failed', result.error);

1. Read [Notification concepts](references/notification-concepts.md) for package ownership and delivery status semantics.
2. For plugin registration, configuration, migrations, or test APIs, read [Integration and configuration](references/integration-and-configuration.md). Configure a Channel name mapped to one flat Provider configuration.
3. For sending or typed consumers, read [Sending notifications](references/sending-notifications.md). Resolve `notificationServiceToken`; construct complete messages keyed by Channel name and use native recipient addresses. Validate the intended external effect before sending.
4. For failures and retries, read [Delivery diagnostics](references/delivery-diagnostics.md). Preserve Notification, Delivery, Attempt, and retry-audit history; distinguish accepted submission from final delivery.
5. For custom transports, read [Channel and Provider extensions](references/channel-and-provider-extensions.md). Register globally unique Provider definitions through `notificationExtensionRegistryToken` and retain the queue/lease/retry lifecycle.
6. Verify changed packages and consumers with lint, typecheck, tests, and build. Cover atomic validation, independent delivery, recipient rules, and retries bound to original identities.

The test API requires authentication and its test header; submission additionally requires `notification:test` `send`. A test notification is a real send. Select only the Channel and provide the fields required by its message type. Credentials stay on the server.

E10 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification/references/integration-and-configuration.md:49–55

文档列出三个测试端点及其认证/测试头/权限差异，说明目标是注册定义与已启用实例的交集、只暴露安全元数据、每次测试都产生持久日志且状态仅创建者可见，并提示生产测试是真实对外发送。

## Notification test surface

The core package exposes `GET /api/notifications/test/targets`, `POST /api/notifications/test/send`, and `GET /api/notifications/test/:id/status`. All three require authentication and `x-nocobase-notification-test: 1`; only `POST /send` requires the `notification:test` `send` permission. Logs remain separately protected by `page:notification.logs` `access`.

Targets are the intersection of registered definitions and enabled configured instances. Their public descriptors contain only Channel names, Provider identifiers, labels, and safe form-field metadata. Configuration, Webhook URLs, API keys, and secrets stay on the server. Channel definitions convert test fields into the same normal `send()` inputs; each test creates persistent logs, and status is visible only to its creating user.

A production test is a real external send and requires explicit scope, the recipient or recipientless mode, Channel, permission, and follow-up verification.

E11 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification/references/notification-concepts.md:5–7

文档定义 Notification/Delivery/Attempt 分层，说明 accepted 仅代表 Provider 受理、retrying/failed/unknown 的含义与重试绑定原始渠道与 Provider 标识。

A Notification is one logical send identified by `idempotencyKey`. Each Channel and native recipient produces an independent Delivery. Each Provider submission creates an Attempt. All entries in `messages` execute; one failed delivery does not stop the others. The runtime preserves queues, timeouts, leases, automatic retries, manual retry audits, status queries, and realtime inbox invalidations.

`accepted` means the Provider accepted the submission, not that the recipient read it. Known transient failures can schedule a same-Provider retry. `retrying` means the next attempt is scheduled and `nextRunAt` records its earliest execution time. `failed` is a terminal known failure that may be manually retried. `unknown` means submission may have succeeded and must be checked with external Provider evidence before a new logical send. A retry remains bound to the original Channel name and Provider identifier. Removing, disabling, or changing that Provider prevents rerouting.

E12 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification/references/delivery-diagnostics.md:36–44

诊断文档说明尝试耗尽后成为终态 failed 且不自动切换到其它 Provider，unknown 时不得直接重试，应借助 Provider 消息 id、外部面板与目标收件证据判断是否提交。

A Provider can request same-Provider retry. Once the configured attempt limit is exhausted, the Delivery becomes terminal failed. The runtime does not fail over to another Provider.

### Partial

Treat every Delivery independently. Identify exactly which recipient/Channel/Provider combinations were accepted and which failed. A new send for only failed combinations is a new Notification and requires duplicate-risk review.

### Unknown

Do not retry an unknown Delivery directly. Use Provider message id when available, external Provider dashboards, target inbox/group evidence, and timestamps to determine whether submission happened. If proof remains unavailable, report an indeterminate external effect. If evidence confirms that no message was submitted, create a new logical Notification with the original business idempotency policy.

E14 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-providers/dist/server/email/providers/smtp.js:117–140

SMTP 传输错误码集合包含 ENOTFOUND 与 EAI_AGAIN，其中可安全重试集合把它们归为 pre_submission，其余传输失败归为 submission_unknown；pre_submission 在 smtpDisposition 中返回 same_provider。

const SMTP_TRANSPORT_ERROR_CODES = new Set([
    'ETIMEDOUT',
    'ECONNRESET',
    'EPIPE',
    'ECONNREFUSED',
    'ENOTFOUND',
    'EAI_AGAIN',
    'ESOCKET',
    'ECONNECTION',
]);
const SMTP_SAFE_RETRY_CODES = new Set([
    'ECONNREFUSED',
    'ENOTFOUND',
    'EAI_AGAIN',
]);
function classifySmtpTransportFailure(error) {
    if (smtpResponseCode(error) !== undefined)
        return undefined;
    const code = providerErrorCode(error);
    if (!code || !SMTP_TRANSPORT_ERROR_CODES.has(code))
        return undefined;
    return SMTP_SAFE_RETRY_CODES.has(code)
        ? 'pre_submission'
        : 'submission_unknown';

## Final delivery validation

The database Provider checks the recipient through Authentication’s user administration service immediately before writing the inbox item. A missing user returns a non-retryable `recipient` failure and creates no inbox item or realtime event. A lookup failure remains a retryable storage failure. Custom hosts calling `createDatabaseProviderDefinition` must supply `recipientExists(userId)` backed by their authoritative user directory; do not use a permissive fallback.

E25 · app/AGENTS.md:100–107

应用指引说明 auth 只控制浏览器导航、管理页用 defineSettingsRoutes 挂到 /settings、开发页用 defineDevRoutes 且后者是构建边界而非权限边界，并要求在路由上声明导航与翻译命名空间。

`auth` controls browser navigation only: `required` for signed-in pages, `guest` for sign-in and registration, `optional` for pages that work either way. It is not server security. An endpoint the page calls enforces its own authentication independently.

Use `defineSettingsRoutes()` for administrative pages, which mount under `/settings`, and `defineDevRoutes()` for development-only pages, which mount under `/dev` and are absent from a production build. Do not repeat `/settings` or `/dev` in the path. `defineDevRoutes()` is a build boundary, not a permission boundary: a page that must be restricted in production is a settings route with `authz`, enforced by the server.

**Declare navigation on the route.** App, Settings and Dev menus read `navigation: { title: 'navigation.orders' }`; titles resolve in the owning locale namespace. Add the translation in `client/locales/`. Refine resources remain for CRUD and do not add menu entries.

Use recursive groups to organize menus; their path is optional. Pages may also have children, but must manually render `Outlet`. For URL-addressable dialogs and drawers, declare the child in `defineAppRoutes()` in `client/routes.ts`, place the owning page's `Outlet`, then render `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`. Call `useRouteOverlay()` only from a descendant rendered inside the overlay, including its footer, never from the page returning the wrapper. Read `.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/overlay.md` before implementing overlays or close guards.

E28 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/ui-workflow.md:1–20

前端 workflow 区分 full 与 quick workflow，规定各自的阅读材料与静态检查命令，并明确 quick change 不写设计文件、不做浏览器测试或启动评审子代理。

# Frontend development workflow

This is the entry point for the application's frontend work: read it before writing or changing anything under `client/` — pages, components, styles or copy. It covers only which workflow to follow, what to do at each step, and what counts as done. It says which changes take the full workflow (write a design file and review it once, then run one independent acceptance review after development), which can be a quick change (edit directly and run static checks only), and which parts of `ui-guidelines.md` and `frontend-dev.md` to read at each step. What the interface should look like is in `ui-guidelines.md`; how to write the code is in `frontend-dev.md`. Paths in this document are relative to its own directory: `ui-guidelines.md` and `frontend-dev.md` sit beside it, the topic references are under `references/`, and the record templates are under `templates/`.

## Choosing a workflow

Decide before you start, and say in one sentence in your reply which workflow you are following and why.

| Workflow      | When it applies                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Full workflow | Any one of: a new page; a new complete interaction (a create/edit flow, a detail drawer, a multi-step operation); a change to the page structure or main interactions; one change that touches the UI of several pages; the user asks to see the design first |
| Quick change  | None of the above applies. For example: changing copy; adjusting styling details; adding a button, a column, a form field or a filter to an existing page; fixing a UI bug; a refactor that changes neither appearance nor behavior                           |

When unsure, explain the difference in one sentence (the full workflow adds a design, a design review and an independent acceptance review) and let the user choose.

## Quick change

1. Read `frontend-dev.md` and the references under `references/` related to the change. When the change affects how the interface looks or behaves, also read the relevant guidelines in `ui-guidelines.md`, and at minimum check the relevant items of the "Review checklist" at its end.
2. Follow how the page is already written: keep components, spacing and copy style consistent with what surrounds the change.
3. Run static checks on the changed files only: `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings 0 <files>`, `pnpm exec prettier --check <files>`.

E30 · app/client/pages/notification-test/api.ts:8–41

应用 API 封装说明测试端点必须携带 x-nocobase-notification-test 头且仍有会话与 notification:test send 权限，并据此调用 targets/send。

/**
 * The notification test endpoints refuse a request without this header, so only an explicit test entry can reach
 * them. The header is not authentication; the routes still require a session and the `notification:test send`
 * permission.
 */
const TEST_HEADER = { 'x-nocobase-notification-test': '1' } as const;

/** List the channels the application offers for a test, with their fields. */
export async function listTestTargets(
  api: ApiClient,
): Promise<readonly NotificationTestTarget[]> {
  const response = await api.request<{ data: NotificationTestTarget[] }>({
    path: 'notifications/test/targets',
    headers: TEST_HEADER,
  });
  return response.data;
}

/** Ask the application to send one test notification on a single channel. */
export async function sendTestNotification(
  api: ApiClient,
  request: {
    readonly channel: string;
    readonly values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  },
): Promise<NotificationTestSendResult> {
  const response = await api.request<{ data: NotificationTestSendResult }>({
    path: 'notifications/test/send',
    method: 'POST',
    headers: TEST_HEADER,
    json: request,
  });
  return response.data;
}

E40 · app/AGENTS.md:399–405

应用指引中的 Factory task termination 与 Controlled failed-delivery smoke 段落；后者正是模板提交 e318f4e 引入、随后被修复轮删除多余空行的段落。

Ordinary tasks and evaluation samples share the ceilings in `.github/scripts/task-policy.mjs`: five repair attempts, three observations of an identical failure per criterion/check, at most one five-hour Handoff, and ten hours of active implementation/repair/QA time. An evaluation plan can only tighten these limits. Pipeline state carries counters, failure fingerprints and elapsed time across handoffs and explicit recoveries; never clear them to get a task through.

A terminal limit saves `task-diagnostic.json` and `task-diagnostic.md`, preserves the patch and raw evidence, and runs at most one additional fifteen-minute read-only diagnosis using the independent reviewer. This cleanup cannot resume repairs, dispatch another continuation, or authorize final verification. Failed tasks still publish reports and create or update a build PR marked failed when a safe code diff exists. They may attempt preview packaging and deployment once without restarting repair or QA; preview failure does not block the report or PR or change the failed task status. Missing patches or empty diffs must be reported explicitly rather than fabricating a PR. Stopped checkpoints are not recoverable. Reject direct GitHub Re-run attempts for implementation/repair: they start fresh runners without restoring the previous attempt. Use explicit checkpoint recovery in a new Run for recoverable failures. Attribute framework, Skill, template, application, factory and environment issues from evidence; repeated failures alone are not proof of a NocoBase3 defect. Preserve unknown causes and incomplete diagnoses.

## Controlled failed-delivery smoke

The task workflow's opt-in failure_smoke dispatch input exercises failed publication without model calls or business QA. It requires a fresh, open Issue carrying factory:external, factory:failure-smoke, and the <!-- factory-failure-smoke:v1 --> disclosure. Do not use recovery or GitHub Re-run for this mode. The pinned code-only fixture comes from Issue #400 / PR #401; it carries its source SHA and patch digest and never copies earlier QA verdicts or screenshots. The agent job deliberately fails before QA; the existing failed PR, report, packaging and deployment jobs must handle it unchanged. Do not merge its application PR or describe successful preview deployment as successful business acceptance.

原始验收要求

向指定测试接收端发送一次，通知最终记录与实际接收结果一致；排队或已受理不等于已送达。测试收件端若没有浏览器入口，则接收证据由独立测试步骤提供，浏览器结果不能单独证明外部送达。

实际操作

  1. 以 nocobase/admin123 登录后进入 Settings > Notification test 页面，确认两个单选项 test-inbox · Built-in（目标 Super Admin 登录用户收件箱）与 test-failure · SMTP，且默认选中 test-inbox。
  2. 保持选中 test-inbox，点击 Send test notification 提交一次。
  3. 读取即时反馈弹窗：Notification e85a10e2-e895-4184-98b6-8c4259e21845 was accepted (completed)。
  4. 打开 View notification logs，展开该通知，读取 Source=notification-test、Notification ID=e85a10e2-…、Status=completed、Deliveries=1，交付明细 Channel=test-inbox、Provider=Built-in、Status=accepted、Attempts=1、#1 Built-in accepted。
  5. 用浏览器当前已认证会话访问应用内收件箱 durable API /main/api/notifications/in-app 与 /unread-count，核对实际接收结果。

观察结果

  1. 最终记录与真实接收一致：收件箱项 id=267f8a1d-…，其 deliveryId=9da97dbe-f790-47b3-85c7-84d596060a3f 与诊断记录中该交付的 delivery id 完全一致，notificationId=e85a10e2-… 也与诊断记录一致。
  2. 收件箱项 userId=1b0c7164-7361-4d22-b091-df2b05ca3f19，与 get-session 返回的当前登录用户 id 相同，证明发往指定测试收件端（登录用户收件箱）而非他人。
  3. 收件箱标题 NocoBase notification test、正文 This is a test notification from NocoBase.，unread-count=1，为真实持久化的收件箱条目。
  4. 交付状态为 in-app Provider 的终态 accepted/notification completed；按 Skill 定义 accepted 仅表示 Provider 受理，因此另以 durable 收件箱条目作为独立接收证据，未仅凭 accepted 判定送达。
  5. 验证过程中页面无 Something went wrong、无空白页、无未处理异常；errors 命令无页面错误输出。
  6. 接收端无生产浏览器页面（插件 Dev Route /main/dev/notification-in-app 在构建中重定向回 /main），故接收证据取自应用自身已认证的 durable 收件箱 API。
